landing.hero_title_2: Build a more resilient food system.
landing.hero_p1: Food Systems Financing Intelligence helps the Government of Rwanda and its development partners see how to allocate funds across the food system. It supports setting national goals and improving overall food system outcomes.
landing.hero_p2: For Rwanda, FSFI works with 37 indicators grouped in 8 components. Stronger, better-targeted allocation across these areas supports food systems resilience and leaves the country less exposed when shocks arrive.
landing.components_sub: Defined for Rwanda's context and aligned with national priorities.
landing.cta_access_body: Sign in with your government credentials.
landing.feature1_desc: Run the index by fiscal year across 37 indicators and 8 components. You see gaps, stress, and damage that adds up over time. Each run is saved. Pick hybrid, expert, financial, network, or equal weighting. The audited Rust engine does the math.
landing.feature2_desc: See agriculture-related spending on the same indicators, from FY 2018. Yearly totals, how the mix shifts, volatility, and the biggest movers. For budget and economic work. It is not the FSFSI score.
landing.feature3_desc: Tools for efficiency, reallocation, and ROI. Multi-year plans and MTEF-style outputs. Save plans and try other budgets and splits. Budget alignment uses the same planning rules.
landing.feature4_desc: Browse by fiscal year. PSTA 5 alignment. Province and district views when we have the data. Reports and alerts for follow-up.

about_page.hero_lead: Food Systems Financing Intelligence is a decision-support platform that helps Rwanda's government understand where to invest and what impact to expect. Donors and partners can use the same evidence to align support with national food system goals and track results.
about_page.challenge_intro: Food system budgets must cover many priorities. Leaders need clear answers on where money does the most good, how spending links to resilience, and how to explain trade-offs to partners and the public.
about_page.challenge_q1: Where should the next franc go to improve the system as a whole?
about_page.challenge_q2: How do allocations line up with national goals and PSTA 5?
about_page.challenge_q3: What mix of investment reduces vulnerability when shocks hit?
about_page.provides_fsfsi: FSFI computes the Food System Financing Stress Index (FSFSI). It brings together 37 indicators in 8 components to describe stress and pressure in the food system, so budgets and investments can be grounded in data.
about_page.card_assess_body: Shows how Rwanda’s food system is doing across dimensions that matter for outcomes and resilience.
about_page.card_gaps_body: Compares current results to benchmarks so underperforming areas stand out.
about_page.card_invest_body: Supports choices on where extra funding will matter most for national goals.
about_page.card_track_body: Links spending and results to PSTA 5 and year-on-year trends.
about_page.components_intro: For Rwanda, FSFI has identified 37 indicators within 8 components. They reflect the country's context and national priorities. Improving them through clearer, optimal allocation sets Rwanda on a path toward food systems resilience and a system less prone to collapse after shocks.
about_page.gov_title: How government and partners use FSFI
about_page.gov_budget_body: MINAGRI, MINECOFIN, and partners use FSFSI and related tools to highlight priority areas and justify allocation choices with evidence.
about_page.gov_perf_body: Check whether investments are delivering intended outcomes and compare results to PSTA 5 targets.
about_page.gov_adv_body: Share quantitative evidence with development partners so external finance lines up with national food system goals.
about_page.partners_intro: FSFI was developed with leading African and international research institutions.
about_page.cta_body: Sign in with your government credentials to access the dashboard.

planning.title: Strategic Planning
planning.subtitle: Multi-year FSFSI trajectory and MTEF for country-level decision making.
planning.no_assessment_message: Run an FSFI assessment for the selected fiscal year to enable strategic planning and MTEF.
planning.parameters_help: Set target and horizon; both multi-year and 3-year MTEF are generated. Budget growth rate applies to both the trajectory and MTEF.
planning.horizon_start_fy_hint: Maps horizon rows to FY labels (Year 2 = this + 1, etc.). Default is the year after the assessment fiscal year.
planning.alignment_help: Expand a year and enter component budgets in billions RWF. The national total is the sum of those lines. Your percentage split updates as you type. The tool compares your scale to the plan and runs a cumulative FSFSI projection with your mix, using the same stress rules as strategic planning.
planning.alignment_cumulative_note: Strategic planning anchors on **cumulative** stress from the assessment. The simulator uses the same computation engine as the planner with matching per-indicator budgets. When your total and mix match the optimal plan, the projection aligns with the chart.
planning.alignment_mix_help: Amounts add up to your national total. “Your %” is derived from your split (always sums to 100%).
planning.alignment_fsfsi_compare: Cumulative FSFSI after your allocation (this horizon year)
planning.alignment_worse: Higher cumulative stress than the optimal plan for this year. Check your mix and total funding.
planning.alignment_above_target: Above the planned milestone target for this year.
planning.alignment_prior_missing: Missing prior-year plan data; cannot simulate year 2+.
planning.alignment_actual_hint: This year's actual allocation is recorded
planning.alignment_footnote: Simulation uses planning weights/scenario you selected above. It does not re-run a full indicator-level assessment; for official scores, run Assessment after budgets are fixed in the system.
planning.budget_increase_over_plan: Planned budget increase (by end of plan)
planning.budget_increase_hint: Extra budget over the plan to reach the target. This is not a funding gap.
planning.section_multiyear_desc: Trajectory, budget evolution and outcomes for your chosen planning horizon.
planning.section_mtef_desc: Separate rolling 3-year plan with its own target (improvement %) and budget growth.
planning.trajectory_help: Projected vs year target; green line is final target.
planning.mtef_help: Rolling 3-year plan with target improvement and budget growth.
planning.mtef_diff_note: MTEF is a separate 3-year plan: it uses the improvement % and budget growth rate above. Its Year 3 target is baseline × (1 − improvement %), not the absolute target used in the trajectory chart. Projected FSFSI can be better than that target when budget growth is high.
planning.saved_plans_help: Open a stored plan, set one as active for the National Overview, or start a new draft. Select up to three plans to compare trajectories.
planning.saved_plans_empty: No saved plans for this fiscal year yet. Generate a plan below, then use Save Plan.
planning.viewing_saved: You are viewing a saved plan. Adjust parameters and click Generate plans to explore alternatives, or Start new plan to clear the canvas.
planning.compare_help: Side-by-side parameters and projected FSFSI paths (multi-year trajectory only).
planning.saved_invalid_json: This saved plan could not be loaded (missing data).
planning.saved_open_failed: Could not open the saved plan.
planning.compare_failed: Could not load plans for comparison.
planning.saved_different_assessment: This plan was saved from a different assessment run than the one loaded now. Regenerate assessments if you need numbers aligned with current data.
planning.save_new_title: Save this plan as the official strategic plan
planning.save_new_help: Plan names must be unique for this fiscal year (case-insensitive). Saving a new plan deactivates any previous active plan for the year.
planning.save_update_help: Changes to parameters or weighting regenerate the stored trajectory. Renaming must stay unique for this fiscal year.
planning.delete_confirm: Permanently delete this saved plan? This cannot be undone.

budget_page.title: Budget Analysis
budget_page.subtitle: Multi-year mapped public spending in weighted LCU billions. See where money went, how shares shifted, and mapping quality. Built for economists and policymakers. FSFSI, stress, and reallocation are on Assessment, Optimization, and Strategic Planning.
budget_page.scope_note: All series come from the budget-mapping pipeline (IndicatorData), not from FSFSI assessments.
budget_page.no_data: No mapped budget data yet. Run import_budget_mapping (pipeline Step 1) first.
budget_page.metric_vol_hint: Std. dev. of year-on-year % change in national weighted total
budget_page.metric_hhi_hint: Across food-system components; higher = more concentrated
budget_page.chart_national_help: Sum of indicator weighted allocations in billions LCU.
budget_page.chart_share_title: Largest components, share of national total
budget_page.chart_share_help: Percent of national weighted budget by component (top five by latest year).
budget_page.drift_help: Change in percentage points of national weighted total.
budget_page.movers_help: Ranks use weighted LCU each year. Level Δ% and CAGR need a positive allocation at the start (and CAGR also at the end); starting from zero makes percent growth undefined, so those cells show an em dash. Share Δ (ppt) is always defined: change in this indicator’s share of the national mapped total.
budget_page.mover_cagr_hint: Geometric growth of this indicator’s weighted total; only when first and last year are both greater than zero.
budget_page.mover_level_hint: Percent change in this indicator’s weighted total vs the first year; only when the first year is greater than zero.
budget_page.mover_share_hint: Change in percentage points of national mapped total (first year vs last year).
budget_page.quality_help: Mapped budget lines versus fallback estimates. More fallback can mean weaker links to programmes.
budget_page.snapshot_help: Detailed indicator table for the end year of the window (same definitions as pipeline).
